plugin.name: Temperans Habits
settings.organizeByYearMonth: Organize logs by year and month
desc.abstinence: 0 means complete abstinence. Entering 0 or leaving unlogged builds your streak.
desc.abstinenceSlip: 0 means complete abstinence. Entering 0 or leaving unlogged is a success and builds your streak. Any value above this counts as a slip.
desc.habitType: Build habit (positive target), avoidance habit (negative/avoid), or zero-goal tracker.
desc.heatmapColor: Controls the heat-map color scale and respects your active Obsidian theme.
desc.enabled: Disable to hide this habit from your daily completion score.
desc.multiEntry: Log multiple entries with titles and notes throughout the day.
desc.dateFormat: Moment format for dated log filenames, without .md.
desc.dateFormatPlain: Moment format, without .md. Use YYYY-MM-DD for plain filenames.
desc.maxTargetCeiling: Optional ceiling (useful for bounded ranges such as calories).
desc.maxTarget: Optional upper limit for bounded targets.
desc.target100: Required progress amount to achieve 100% completion.
desc.saveNewLogs: Save new logs as YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md. Existing notes stay where they are.
desc.secretKey: Select or enter the key stored in Obsidian secret storage.
desc.vaultFolder: Vault folder for Settings.md and dated habit notes.
ph.exampleHabit: e.g. Daily reading, No sugar, Body weight
note.automatedEndpoint: An automated endpoint supplied {{value}} for this day. Manual entries override automated data.
confirm.deleteHabit: Delete habit “{{name}}”? Existing entries in your daily logs will be preserved.
analytics.shareIntro: Comprehensive performance metrics, volume, consistency, and streaks across all configured tasks.
analytics.copyFailed: Could not copy the summary. Clipboard access may be blocked.

notice.noEndpointsConfigured: No habits with external endpoints are configured in Settings.md.
notice.initFail: Temperans Habits started, but Habit Logs could not be initialized. Check the configured folder in plugin settings.
notice.paired: Temperans Habits: Paired with desktop host.
notice.unknownTask: That task is no longer in Habit Logs/Settings.md.
notice.maxBelowMin: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
